story.originalTitle: F1 race distance: Why 305km and what changes in 2027
story.summaryEn: Formula 1 race distances are determined by the minimum number of laps required to exceed 305 kilometres, with Monaco as the only exception at 260 kilometres. From no standardised distance in 1950 to the 305-kilometre rule set in 1989, the standard is set to drop to 290 kilometres in 2027.
detailZh: 为什么F1正赛长度为305公里？从1950年到2027年的比赛距离
305公里、两小时，或包含中断在内的三小时：F1比赛距离受明确规则约束。我们解释这些规则自1950年以来如何演变、为什么摩纳哥是例外，以及为什么2027年比赛将变短。
一场F1大奖赛的赛程超过305公里。更准确地说，一场比赛由超过305公里所需的最少圈数构成。唯一的例外是摩纳哥，其最低距离为260公里。
实际比赛时间还有两小时限制。如果比赛中断，包含中断时间在内的总时长不得超过三小时。这是现行F1规则的规定。
但情况并非一直如此标准化。在世界锦标赛的最初几十年里，一些比赛的赛程几乎是现在的两倍。而到2027年，距离将再次缩短。比赛实际持续多久以及完成多少圈，也在我们的文章《一场F1比赛持续多久？》中有所说明。
1950年代：比赛长达500公里
1950年F1世界锦标赛开始时，并没有标准的比赛距离。组织者在很大程度上可以自由决定自己赛事的长度，导致差异相当大。
在银石举行的史上第一场世界锦标赛比赛跑了70圈、325公里。冠军尼诺·法里纳用时2小时13分钟完成。相比之下，在蒙扎的赛季收官战中，法里纳跑了80圈、约504公里。他驾驶了将近三个小时。
更长的是印第安纳波利斯500，从1950年到1960年计入世界锦标赛。它共200圈、805公里，至今仍是世界锦标赛历史上圈数和距离都最多的比赛。
1958年，管理机构引入了更严格的限制。比赛距离被设定在300至500公里之间，最长时限为两小时。
在随后的几年里，大多数大奖赛的赛程在300至400公里之间。上限最终定为400公里。
1971年：最长约322公里
1971赛季，最大比赛距离从400公里降至约322公里。比赛因此明显变短。
同一赛季有一个极端例子。在纽博格林北环举行的德国大奖赛仅持续了12圈。由于赛道长度近23公里，这仍是正常完成的世界锦标赛比赛中圈数最少的。
在1970年代和1980年代，大多数比赛稳定在约300至320公里。
1989年，比赛距离被标准化为最低305公里。目的是确保比赛能在两小时内完成。
此后，每场大奖赛都由使总距离刚好超过305公里所需的最少圈数构成。这一基本原则至今仍然有效。
例如在2026年，这意味着在赛道长度超过七公里的斯帕-弗朗科尔尚为44圈。巴库为51圈，雪邦为56圈。摩纳哥圈数最多，为78圈。
摩纳哥例外：为什么比赛只有260公里
摩纳哥是唯一不适用305公里规则的赛道。这个公国的比赛为78圈、约260公里。
原因是速度。这条街道赛道仅长3.337公里，而且狭窄多弯。平均速度远低于其他赛道。
因此，在摩纳哥跑超过305公里可能会因平均速度低而导致比赛异常漫长。这就是摩纳哥最低比赛距离为260公里的原因。
2011年加拿大站：迄今为止最长的F1比赛
多年来，只有对实际比赛时间的两小时限制。没有规则规定计入中断后比赛可以持续多久。2011年加拿大大奖赛后，这种情况改变了。
蒙特利尔的大雨使比赛中断了约两个小时。简森·巴顿最终在一次惊人的逆转后获胜。官方比赛用时为4:04:39.537，成为F1历史上最长的比赛。
FIA迅速作出回应。从2012年起，包含中断在内的比赛不得超过四小时。实际比赛的两小时限制仍然保留。2021赛季，总时限被缩减为三小时。
2021年比利时站：最短比赛和新积分规则
2021年在斯帕-弗朗科尔尚，F1经历了相反的极端情况。持续降雨意味着车队只在安全车后绕行。官方成绩中仅计入一圈。
根据当时有效的规则，仍然授予了半分。这引发了广泛批评。
因此，自2022年起，对于缩短的比赛，只要在无安全车或虚拟安全车的情况下完成至少两圈，积分便按滑动比例授予：
两圈至比赛距离的25%：前五名获得积分（6-4-3-2-1）。
自2023年起，当暂停的比赛恢复后，即使最终未完成全部预定距离，也授予全额积分。
部分比赛周末在大奖赛之外还设有冲刺赛。冲刺赛约100公里，约为正常比赛距离的三分之一，通常持续约半小时。
没有强制进站。前八名获得积分（8-7-6-5-4-3-2-1）。2026年赛历中有六场冲刺赛。该赛制的完整细节可在《F1冲刺赛：你需要知道的一切》中找到。
从2027年起，标准比赛距离将从305公里降至290公里。据FIA称，这相当于减少约两到三圈。
F1委员会已批准这一缩减，但仍需FIA世界汽车运动理事会最终批准。
基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯，马克斯·维斯塔潘，红牛车队，兰多·诺里斯，迈凯伦
与此同时，目前对受中断影响比赛的三小时总时限将被废除。取而代之的是，将为比赛活动的结束引入固定的硬性截止时间。实际比赛的两小时限制将保留。
detailEn: Why is a Formula 1 race 305 kilometres long? Race distances from 1950 to 2027

305 kilometres, two hours, or three hours including interruptions: Formula 1 race distances are governed by clear rules. We explain how those rules have evolved since 1950, why Monaco is an exception and why races will become shorter in 2027.

A Formula 1 Grand Prix is more than 305 kilometres long. More precisely, a race consists of the minimum number of laps required to exceed 305 kilometres. The only exception is Monaco, where the minimum distance is 260 kilometres.

There is also a two-hour limit on actual racing time. If a race is suspended, the total duration including the interruption may not exceed three hours. That is what the current Formula 1 regulations stipulate.

But it has not always been this standardised. During the first decades of the World Championship, some races were almost twice as long. And in 2027, the distance will be reduced again. How long a race lasts in practice and how many laps are completed is also explained in our article How long does a Formula 1 race last?
The 1950s: Races of up to 500 kilometres

When the Formula 1 World Championship began in 1950, there was no standard race distance. Organisers were largely free to determine the length of their own events, resulting in considerable variation.

The very first World Championship race at Silverstone ran for 70 laps and 325 kilometres. Winner Nino Farina completed it in 2 hours and 13 minutes. At the season finale in Monza, by contrast, Farina raced for 80 laps and around 504 kilometres. He was behind the wheel for almost three hours.

Longer still was the Indianapolis 500, which counted towards the World Championship from 1950 to 1960. At 200 laps and 805 kilometres, it remains the race with both the highest number of laps and the greatest distance in World Championship history.
In 1958, the governing body introduced much tighter restrictions. Race distances were set at between 300 and 500 kilometres, with a maximum duration of two hours.
In the years that followed, most Grands Prix covered between 300 and 400 kilometres. The upper limit was eventually 400 kilometres.
1971: A maximum of around 322 kilometres
For the 1971 season, the maximum race distance was reduced from 400 to around 322 kilometres. Races consequently became noticeably shorter.

One extreme example came that same season. The German Grand Prix on the Nürburgring Nordschleife lasted just 12 laps. With the circuit measuring almost 23 kilometres, it remains the lowest number of laps in a regularly completed World Championship race.
During the 1970s and 1980s, most races settled at around 300 to 320 kilometres.
In 1989, the race distance was standardised at a minimum of 305 kilometres. The aim was to ensure that a race could be completed within two hours.
Since then, each Grand Prix has consisted of the minimum number of laps required to take the total distance just beyond 305 kilometres. The basic principle remains in place today.
In 2026, for example, that means 44 laps at Spa-Francorchamps, where the circuit is more than seven kilometres long. Baku has 51 laps and Sepang 56. Monaco has the highest lap count at 78.
The Monaco exception: Why the race is only 260 kilometres
Monaco is the only circuit where the 305-kilometre rule does not apply. The race in the Principality covers 78 laps and around 260 kilometres.
The reason is speed. The street circuit is only 3.337 kilometres long, as well as being narrow and twisty. Average speeds are considerably lower than at other circuits.

Covering more than 305 kilometres in Monaco would therefore risk producing an exceptionally long race because of the low average speed. That is why Monaco has a minimum race distance of 260 kilometres.
Canada 2011: The longest Formula 1 race to date

For many years, there was only a two-hour limit on actual racing time. There was no rule governing how long a race could last once interruptions were taken into account. That changed after the 2011 Canadian Grand Prix.

Heavy rain stopped the race in Montreal for around two hours. Jenson Button eventually won after a spectacular comeback drive. The official race time was 4:04:39.537, making it the longest race in Formula 1 history.

The FIA responded quickly. From 2012, a race including interruptions could last no more than four hours. The two-hour limit on actual racing remained in place. For the 2021 season, the overall limit was reduced to three hours.
Belgium 2021: The shortest race and new points rules

Formula 1 experienced the opposite extreme at Spa-Francorchamps in 2021. Persistent rain meant the field only circulated behind the Safety Car. Just one lap was included in the official classification.
Under the rules in force at the time, half points were nevertheless awarded. That prompted widespread criticism.
Since 2022, a sliding scale has therefore applied to points awarded for shortened races, provided that at least two laps have been completed without the Safety Car or Virtual Safety Car:
Two laps to 25 per cent of the race distance: points for the top five (6-4-3-2-1).
25 to 50 per cent: points for the top nine (13-10-8-6-5-4-3-2-1).
50 to 75 per cent: points for the top 10 (19-14-12-9-8-6-5-3-2-1).
Since 2023, full points have also been awarded when a suspended race is resumed, even if the full scheduled distance is ultimately not completed.
Selected race weekends also feature a Sprint alongside the Grand Prix. It covers around 100 kilometres, roughly one-third of the distance of a normal race, and usually lasts around half an hour.

There is no mandatory pit stop. Points are awarded to the top eight finishers (8-7-6-5-4-3-2-1). Six Sprints feature on the 2026 calendar. Full details of the format can be found in Formula 1 Sprint: Everything you need to know.
From 2027, the standard race distance is set to fall from 305 to 290 kilometres. According to the FIA, that equates to around two or three fewer laps.
The Formula 1 Commission has approved the reduction, although it still requires final approval from the FIA World Motor Sport Council.
Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes, Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, Lando Norris, McLaren

At the same time, the current three-hour overall limit for races affected by interruptions is set to be abolished. Instead, a fixed hard stop will be introduced for the end of racing activity. The two-hour limit on actual racing time will remain.

In 1971 the maximum race distance was reduced from 400 to around 322 kilometres; in 1989 a minimum standard of 305 kilometres was established.

The 2011 Canadian Grand Prix was stopped for around two hours due to heavy rain and had an official race time of 4:04:39.537, making it the longest race in F1 history; an overall time limit was subsequently introduced and reduced to three hours in 2021.

detailZh: F1美国大奖赛：汉密尔顿在FP3中险胜维斯塔潘
法拉利在COTA的每节练习中都排名第一，进入排位赛
汉密尔顿在F1美国大奖赛的最后一节练习中排名第一，领先维斯塔潘和勒克莱尔进入奥斯汀的排位赛
在第三节的最后20分钟里，汉密尔顿是唯一打破1分35秒大关的车手，频繁的越界行为使得法拉利队友勒克莱尔无法超越他登上排行榜。
本节练习的前三圈只能用平淡无奇来形容，但随着汉密尔顿在软胎上跑出1分36.716秒，超越了多个使用中等轮胎的圈速。
不久后，小红牛车队和迈凯轮的利亚姆·劳森打破了汉密尔顿的成绩，而几位重量级选手仍在使用中等轮胎进行圈速测试。
尽管范斯特appen对换挡时的不稳定状态有所抱怨，但他凭借黄色侧壁轮胎的1分35.702秒成绩名列前茅。
汉密尔顿迅速提升了成绩，使用软胎跑出了1分35.561秒。但勒克莱尔尽管使用的是较慢的中胎，却以1分35.127秒的成绩接管了领先位置，这表明还有更多的速度可以挖掘。
进入最后20分钟，安东内利在软胎上比勒克莱尔快了十分之一，但他在9号弯道超出了赛道限制，导致这一圈被取消。
维斯塔潘遵守了白线，以1分35.061秒的成绩排名第一，红牛车队在第一区段是最快的，但汉密尔顿的成绩低于1分35秒，达到了1分34.893秒。
在整个练习过程中一直出现的赛道限制问题，也阻止了勒克莱尔重新夺回第一的位置，因为他在10号弯道越过了白线。
这意味着摩纳哥车手只能满足于排在汉密尔顿和维斯塔潘之后，为周六下午的排位赛设置了一场紧张激烈的局面。
冠军车手安东内利排在第四位，领先于梅赛德斯车队的队友乔治·拉塞尔，银箭车队似乎在纯速度上落后半步，皮亚斯蒂在难以驾驭的MCL40中排在第六位。
在奥迪车队，尼科·胡肯伯格阻止了麦克拉伦车队的兰多·诺里斯获得第七名，世界冠军的1分35.2秒成绩也因为第十弯的赛道限制而被取消。
阿尔派车队的皮埃尔·加斯利排在第九位，落后汉密尔顿一秒，伊萨克·哈德贾在第二辆小红牛车队中排在第十位，这位法国车手因为他的赛车操控问题而感到沮丧。
detailEn: F1 United States GP: Lewis Hamilton pips Max Verstappen in FP3
Ferrari heads into qualifying having topped every practice session at COTA
Lewis Hamilton finished final practice on top at Formula 1's United States Grand Prix, leading Max Verstappen and Charles Leclerc into qualifying at Austin.

Hamilton was the only driver to break the 1m35s barrier in the final 20 minutes of third practice, as frequent track limits transgressions kept Ferrari team-mate Leclerc from leapfrogging him on the leaderboard.
Following an opening quarter of the session which can only be described as pedestrian, action picked up as Hamilton set a 1m36.716s on softs to get ahead of a number of medium-tyred install laps.
His time was soon beaten by Liam Lawson in the Racing Bulls and McLaren's Oscar Piastri, while several heavy hitters kept turning laps on medium tyres instead.
Verstappen even went top courtesy of a 1m35.702s on the yellow sidewall tyre, despite recurring complaints about his unsettling downshifts.

Hamilton swiftly improved upon the Dutchman's lap, using softs to set a 1m35.561s. But when Leclerc took over command with a 1m35.127s despite using the slower mediums, that underlined there was still a lot more pace to find.
Entering the final 20 minutes, Antonelli took a tenth out of Leclerc's time on softs, but his lap was scratched for breaking track limits at Turn 9.
Verstappen did adhere to the white lines to set a 1m35.061s and go top, with Red Bull the quickest car through sector one, only for Hamilton to dip below the 1m35s barrier with a 1m34.893s.
Track limits, which have been a recurring theme throughout practice, also kept Leclerc from reclaiming first as he dipped over the white line at Turn 10.
That meant the Monegasque had to settle for third behind Hamilton and Verstappen, setting up a finely poised qualifying session on Saturday afternoon.

Championship leader Antonelli was fourth ahead of Mercedes team-mate George Russell, as the Silver Arrows appears to be a half-step behind on pure pace, with Piastri sixth in the difficult to tame MCL40.
In the Audi, Nico Hulkenberg kept McLaren’s Lando Norris from seventh, with the world champion’s 1m35.2s also deleted for track limits at Turn 10.
Alpine driver Pierre Gasly was ninth, a full second behind Hamilton, with Isack Hadjar 10th in the second Red Bull as the Frenchman was left frustrated by his car's handling.

detailZh: 丹尼尔·里卡多在美国大奖赛前夕的现场表演令F1粉丝感到惊喜
前F1车手丹尼尔·里卡多与音乐家罗布·贝尔德一起吹奏口琴，令粉丝感到惊喜
丹尼尔·里卡多，Drive to Survive第七季
赛车文化超越赛道。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计和那些让赛车不仅仅是一项运动的故事。
前一级方程式车手丹尼尔·里卡多在美国德克萨斯州奥斯汀的舞台上出现了一个惊喜。
这位澳大利亚人与歌手兼词曲作者罗布·贝尔德一起加入了福特赛车和Enchanté快闪活动，在周五晚上一起演奏他与美国大奖赛旅途中共创作的原创歌曲。
一位粉丝在Instagram上发布的表演视频，截至写作时已经获得了超过7000个赞。一位粉丝评论说：“这治愈了我心中的某一部分，”另一位粉丝补充说：“我敢打赌他上辈子要么是鲍勃·迪伦的兄弟，要么是个牛仔哈哈。我们爱你，丹尼尔。”
“在这个时候，没有人关心比赛。很高兴看到丹尼尔回来了，即使他不再赛车，”另一位粉丝写道，另一位粉丝写道：“作为一个音乐家和蜜獾粉丝，和丹尼·里卡多一起演奏是我的梦想。”
“我是说真的很长的一段路。沙漠、乡村小道、游泳洞，所有这些。说实话，我迫不及待了。”
这次长途旅行是推广新系列 Enchanté Collection 的活动之一，名为《长途》。这些新产品在奥斯汀的 Distribution Hall 的临时展位上出售，展位上还有食品、饮料、闪粉纹身和赛车模拟器。
里卡多也被看到在支持 小红牛 车队的车手利亚姆·劳森，作为新西兰人，他在 Esses Bazaar ATX 活动中担任主角，与利亚姆·劳森和朋友们一起在东第六街的 Inn Cahoots 举办车库音乐会，此次活动是为本周末的美国大奖赛做准备。

Former Formula 1 driver Daniel Ricciardo made a surprise appearance on stage in Austin, Texas, with American singer-songwriter Rob Baird.
The Australian joined Baird at the Ford Racing and Enchanté pop-up on Friday night to play harmonica on an original song he co-wrote with Baird during a road trip to the United States Grand Prix.

A fan video of the performance, posted on Instagram, had picked up more than 7000 likes by the time of writing. "This healed something in me," one fan commented, while another added: "I'm sure he was either Bob Dylan's brother or a cowboy in a previous life lol. We love you, Daniel."

"At this point, no one cares about the race. Glad to see Daniel back, even if he’s not racing," someone else posted, and another fan wrote: "As a musician and a honey badger fan, it would be a dream to play with Danny Ric."
"And I mean the lonnnng way. Desert, backroads, swimming holes, all of it. Not gonna lie, I can't wait."

The road trip was part of the promotion of the new Enchanté collection, The Long Road. The new products are being sold at a pop-up at Distribution Hall in Austin alongside food, drinks, flash tattoos and racing simulators.

Ricciardo was also spotted supporting Racing Bulls driver Liam Lawson as the New Zealander headlined Garage Sessions with Liam Lawson and Friends as part of Esses Bazaar ATX, held at Inn Cahoots on East Sixth Street ahead of this weekend's United States Grand Prix.

detailZh: 尼科·胡肯伯格在美国大奖赛上被加布里埃尔·博特洛托恶作剧后颜面扫地
加布里埃尔·博特洛托在美国大奖赛期间的一次粉丝见面会上玩了一个意外的恶作剧，让他的奥迪车队队友笑得前仰后合
赛车文化超越赛道。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计和那些让赛车不仅仅是一项运动的故事
年轻的奥迪车手加布里埃尔·博特洛托在美洲赛道前与队友尼科·胡肯伯格走在一起时，对他进行了一次恶作剧。两位车手在奥斯汀观众的欢呼声中走出，巴西人拉下了队友的裤子。
这个时刻的视频已经迅速走红，展示了胡肯伯格在周五如何走上舞台，当时博尔特洛从后面抓住他的裤子并将其拉下，引发了观众的欢呼和笑声。这位德国人对此玩笑表示宽容，一边笑着一边整理好衣服。
这个恶作剧为博尔特洛艰难的周末带来了一些轻松。巴西人在周日美国大奖赛将从最后一排发车，因为奥迪为他提供的动力单元组件超出了分配额度。
博尔特洛和胡肯伯格自2025年以来一直是队友，当时车队还以萨博的身份参赛，尽管车队已被德国巨头奥迪接管，但他们成为了赛场上更为轻松的搭档之一。然而，车队在2026年很难获得积分。车队在车队积分榜上排名第八，积分为23分，胡肯伯格积13分，博尔特洛积10分。
博尔特洛在美国大奖赛周末赛前表示：“我在可靠性方面看到了很多改进。显然，我们在新加坡显然有一个问题，我们相信我们已经找到了原因。”
“这显然不是理想的情况，但与此同时，它发生的时候我并没有在前面真正地竞争，所以这让我对它稍微不那么沮丧。但我希望我们能够在接下来的赛季中没有任何重大问题，并且能够以最佳状态完成比赛和排位赛，驾驶我们能够驾驶的最好的汽车，从中提取一切。”
detailEn: Nico Hulkenberg left red-faced after Gabriel Bortoleto prank at United States GP
Gabriel Bortoleto left his Audi team-mate laughing after pulling an unexpected prank during a fan appearance at the United States Grand Prix
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.

Young Audi driver Gabriel Bortoleto played a prank on his team-mate Nico Hulkenberg as the pair walked out in front of thousands of fans at the Circuit of the Americas. With both drivers walking out to cheers from the Austin crowds, the Brazilian pulled down his team-mate's trousers.

Videos of this moment have gone incredibly viral, showing Hulkenberg making his way onto the stage on Friday when Bortoleto grabbed his trousers from behind and pulled them down, to loud cheers and laughter from the crowd. The German took the joke in good humour, laughing as he pulled his clothes straight.

The prank offered some light relief on a tough weekend for Bortoleto. The Brazilian will start Sunday’s United States Grand Prix from the back of the grid, after Audi took him beyond his allocation of power unit components.

Bortoleto and Hulkenberg have been team-mates since 2025, when the team still raced as Sauber, and have formed one of the more light-hearted partnerships on the grid despite it being taken over by German giant Audi. The outfit has found points hard to come by in 2026, however. The team is eighth in the constructors’ championship on 23 points, with the experienced Hulkenberg on 13 and Bortoleto on 10.

"I have seen lots of improvement on reliability," Bortoleto said on Thursday ahead of the United States Grand Prix race weekend. "I think we had one [issue] in Singapore obviously, that we believe we found the reason of.

"It was obviously something not ideal to happen, but at the same time it happened when I was not really fighting at the front, so made me a little bit less upset about it. But I hope we are able to do the rest of the season without having any major issue and that we are able to just complete the races and qualifying in the best condition and the best car possible out there that we can drive and extract everything from it."
